messages:
maya: FYI Gravity (INV-2026-331) pinged support 7: invoice shows SPRING_PROMO twice, total promo -$25 but only one promo should apply. Any objections to a one-line microcredit?
jon: can you attach the invoice snippet?
maya: attached screenshot + pasted lines:
```
SPRING_PROMO   -$12.50
SPRING_PROMO   -$12.50
OTHER_LINE     -$5.00
```
billing-bot: System alert: rule 'promo_dupe_check' matched. Flagging for manual review.
ravi: Looks like a duplicate promo application at billing time. Recommend issuing a single reversal credit $12.50 and mark invoice as corrected. Accounting code: ACCT-CREDIT-MISC.
claire: Approving up to $20. I sign off. Please include "duplicate promo reversal" in reason for audit.
jon: I'll run the adjustment. Command: `/billing adjust INV-2026-331 create-credit --amount 12.50 --reason "duplicate promo reversal (SPRING_PROMO)" --acct ACCT-CREDIT-MISC`
jon: got the manager lock: "manager_approval_required" because system threshold $10.
claire: Approved: Claire (finance manager) approves $12.50 manual goodwill credit.
jon: Re-running: `/billing adjust INV-2026-331 create-credit --amount 12.50 --reason "duplicate promo reversal (SPRING_PROMO)" --acct ACCT-CREDIT-MISC --approved-by claire`
jon: CLI out: `OK: credit CR-2026-792 created; invoice updated; ran reversal posting to ledger batch LB-2026-113.`
billing-bot: Audit note: CR-2026-792 applied to INV-2026-331; note "duplicate SPRING_PROMO reversed per manager approval".
support: Informed Gravity via ticket SUP-48912 that the $12.50 credit has been applied and invoice updated.
maya: closing loop  thanks team :pray:
